_comment: Intended CyberArk safes, memberships and accounts: the file Invoke-SafeReconcile.ps1 compares a vault with.
Roles (audit / use / full) are translated to the 22 safe permissions in RoleMap.psm1, and nowhere else.
The safes mirror the lab's Vault stand-in (pam-policy.json tiers, operators.json): tier0-admins and
tier1-admins library sets become safes; members are groups named for the operators.json roles. Addresses are the
Samba AD harness domain (corp.test.local). No secrets: passwords are set by the CPM, never written here.
Ran against the stub vault only (tests/); never against CyberArk.
